# Kothay Resources

> > Sales tracking and field team management insights for Bangladesh's FMCG, logistics, and NGO sectors

Kothay Resources provides comprehensive guides on GPS tracking, delivery management, and sales performance monitoring tailored for Bangladesh's market. The site covers Kothay.app's solutions for field sales teams, delivery operations in Dhaka and Chittagong, and NGO field officer tracking.

## Key Topics

- Kothay.app
- Sales tracking and performance metrics
- GPS tracking and real-time monitoring
- Field sales management
- Delivery Management Software (DMS)
- Route optimization
- FMCG sales operations
- NGO field operations in Bangladesh
- ePOD (electronic Proof of Delivery)
- Bangladesh logistics (Dhaka, Chittagong)
- Sales forecasting techniques
- CRM integration
- Bank agent monitoring
- Performance improvement plans

## Sales Performance & Team Management

- [Sales Rep Performance Metrics: Boost Your Team's Success in 2025](https://resources.kothay.app/sales-rep-performance-metrics): Guide to sales rep KPIs, quota tracking, and team management metrics
- [How to Do Sales Forecasting: Techniques, Steps, and Tips for Accuracy](https://resources.kothay.app/how-to-do-sales-forecasting): Sales forecasting techniques using historical data and prediction methods
- [আপনার সেলস রিপ্রেজেন্টেটিভরা কাজ করছে কি না জানুন](https://resources.kothay.app/sales-rep-performance-monitoring): Bengali guide: Track sales rep KPIs and field team productivity
- [Employee Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) for Managers](https://resources.kothay.app/employee-performance-improvement-plan): Manager guide to creating PIPs with SMART goals using Kothay tracking

## Delivery & Logistics Management

- [Delivery Management Software: Real-Time Tracking & Efficient Distribution](https://resources.kothay.app/delivery-management-software): Guide to DMS features: route optimization, ePOD, GPS tracking for logistics
- [Advanced Delivery Management Tools in Bangladesh](https://resources.kothay.app/delivery-management-tools-bangladesh): Kothay.app delivery tools for route optimization in Dhaka & Chittagong

## FMCG & Field Sales Solutions

- [Field Sales Tracking App for FMCG Growth in Bangladesh](https://resources.kothay.app/field-sales-tracking-app-for-fmcg): Kothay FMCG sales tracking app with route optimization for Bangladesh
- [বাংলাদেশের ভোগ্যপণ্য কোম্পানির সেলস টিম ম্যানেজ করুন](https://resources.kothay.app/bangladesh-fmcg-sales-team-manage): Bengali guide: FMCG sales team management software for Bangladesh

## NGO & Field Team Monitoring

- [How NGO Organizations in Bangladesh Track Field Officers](https://resources.kothay.app/ngo-organizations-in-bangladesh): GPS tracking for NGO field officers in Bangladesh (BRAC, Cox's Bazar)
- [ফিল্ড টিম মনিটরিং – NGO প্রজেক্ট কার্যকারিতা বাড়ানোর উপায়](https://resources.kothay.app/field-team-monitoring-ngo-efficiency-guide): Bengali guide: NGO field team GPS tracking and performance monitoring
- [ফিল্ডে কাজ করা ব্যাংক এজেন্ট মনিটরিং সফটওয়্যার](https://resources.kothay.app/bank-agent-field-monitoring-software): Bengali guide: Real-time GPS tracking for bank agents in Bangladesh
